# 🍎📦 nutrientprofiler R package

[![docs](https://camo.githubusercontent.com/ccc25400b0edc270f77975557c482e3fb9572c86e44d2985ef8a1e1cb399f3c1/68747470733a2f2f696d672e736869656c64732e696f2f62616467652f446f63756d656e746174696f6e2d6f6e6c696e652d626c7565)](https://leeds-cdrc.github.io/nutrientprofiler/)

Welcome to the nutrientprofiler R package repository!

This package provides functions to help assess product information
against the [UK Nutrient Profiling Model
(2004/5)](https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/the-nutrient-profiling-model)
and scope for [HFSS
legislation](https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/restricting-promotions-of-products-high-in-fat-sugar-or-salt-by-location-and-by-volume-price/restricting-promotions-of-products-high-in-fat-sugar-or-salt-by-location-and-by-volume-price-implementation-guidance)
around product placement.

It is designed to provide low level functions that implement UK Nutrient
Profiling Model scoring that can be applied across product datasets.

## Installation

At present this R package is not available via CRAN. You can however
install it direct from GitHub using
[`remotes`](https://remotes.r-lib.org/).

``` r

install.packages("remotes")

remotes::install_github("Leeds-CDRC/nutrientprofiler")
```

You can also specify a version of the nutrientprofiler package:

``` r

install.packages("remotes")

remotes::install_github("leeds-cdrc/nutrientprofiler@v1.0.0")
```

You can also download the package as an archive from GitHub and install
from source using the following steps. The steps below show how to do
this directly within R but you can also download an archive of the
respository directly from the [GitHub
releases](https://github.com/Leeds-CDRC/nutrientprofiler/releases) page.

``` r

# download the repository as a .tar.gz archive
# to your current directory
download.file("https://github.com/Leeds-CDRC/nutrientprofiler/archive/refs/tags/v0.2.2.tar.gz",
              dest = "./nutrientprofiler-v0.2.2.tar.gz")

# install the package directly from source
install.packages("./nutrientprofiler-v0.2.2.tar.gz", repos = NULL, type="source")
```

## Navigating the documentation

Please see [Getting
started](https://leeds-cdrc.github.io/articles/nutrientprofiler.md) for
an overview of how the `nutrientprofiler` package works.

To learn to prepare your data for analysis, please first see
[Preprocessing](https://leeds-cdrc.github.io/articles/preprocessing.md)
then [Handling input
data](https://leeds-cdrc.github.io/articles/handling_input_data.md). For
more details on valid data types for different parameters, see
[Parameter
guide](https://leeds-cdrc.github.io/articles/parameter_guide.md).

To learn the logic of the specific gravity adjustment workflow, see
[Specific
Gravity](https://leeds-cdrc.github.io/articles/specific_gravity.md), and
to implement custom values for this adjustment, see the guidance in the
article [Custom Specific
Gravity](https://leeds-cdrc.github.io/articles/custom_specific_gravity.md).

# Contributing

This document outlines a rough approach for local setup and contributing
to this project.

## Local setup

To work with this project locally you will need
[Git](https://git-scm.com/) and
[R](https://www.r-project.org/about.html) installed locally. It is also
recommended that you install [Docker](https://www.docker.com/) and
[VSCode](https://code.visualstudio.com/) to enable you to utilise the
[devcontainer](https://code.visualstudio.com/docs/devcontainers/containers)
setup or edit the code directly via GitHub Codespaces.

If you’re unfamiliar with using `git` why not check out the fantastic
[Carpentries introductory
course](https://swcarpentry.github.io/git-novice/).

To get working on this project you will need the
[`devtools`](https://devtools.r-lib.org/) package which you can install
with the following R command:

``` r

# Install devtools from CRAN
install.packages("devtools")
```

### Development workflow

When working locally you should use the following workflow to help
develop the code:

1.  Create a [fork of the GitHub
    repository](https://github.com/Leeds-CDRC/nutrientprofiler/fork) to
    create your own personal copy of this repository to which you can
    push changes to
2.  Locally clone your fork so that you can start working on it
3.  Open an R session
4.  Load `devtools` with: `R library(devtools)`
5.  Make a change to the package files
6.  Test this in your R session by running `load_all()` to load the
    package (check here for any errors)
7.  Check your changes pass tests by running `test()`
8.  If your package passes the tests and you’ve updated the appropriate
    documentation you should now run `check()` locally to make sure all
    appropriate roxygen2 files are created/update and any functions
    you’ve now tagged with @export are exported to NAMESPACE
9.  Commit all the changes from the `check()` run and push these to
    GitHub
10. Open a [pull
    request](https://github.com/Leeds-CDRC/nutrientprofiler/compare)
    against the `main` branch from your development branch. This will
    trigger a GitHub action that also runs the equivalent of `check()`
    to make sure you didn’t miss anything and ensure the package still
    works against different versions of R.
11. Once the checks pass on the pull request your changes can be
    accepted by the maintainer.

# License

The nutrientprofiler package provides functions to help assess product
information against the UK Nutrient Profiling Model (2004/5) and scope
for HFSS legislation around product placement. It is designed to provide
low level functions that implement UK Nutrient Profiling Model scoring
that can be applied across product datasets.

# Package index

## Specific Gravity Conversion

Functions related to specific gravity conversion

- [`SGConverter()`](https://leeds-cdrc.github.io/nutrientprofiler/reference/SGConverter.md)
  : Specific Gravity converter function
- [`sg_cord_drink_converter()`](https://leeds-cdrc.github.io/nutrientprofiler/reference/sg_cord_drink_converter.md)
  : Specific gravity drink converter for cordial drinks
- [`sg_drink_converter()`](https://leeds-cdrc.github.io/nutrientprofiler/reference/sg_drink_converter.md)
  : Specific gravity drink dispatcher
- [`sg_food_converter()`](https://leeds-cdrc.github.io/nutrientprofiler/reference/sg_food_converter.md)
  : Specific gravity food dispatcher
- [`sg_liquidfood_converter()`](https://leeds-cdrc.github.io/nutrientprofiler/reference/sg_liquidfood_converter.md)
  : Specific gravity liquid converter
- [`sg_powd_drink_converter()`](https://leeds-cdrc.github.io/nutrientprofiler/reference/sg_powd_drink_converter.md)
  : Specific gravity drink converter for powdered drinks
- [`sg_ready_drink_converter()`](https://leeds-cdrc.github.io/nutrientprofiler/reference/sg_ready_drink_converter.md)
  : Specific gravity drink converter for ready to consume drinks
- [`generic_specific_gravity()`](https://leeds-cdrc.github.io/nutrientprofiler/reference/generic_specific_gravity.md)
  : Generic specific gravity converter

## Nutrient Profile Model Scoring

Functions related to Nutrient Profile Model scoring for specific
nutrients

- [`NPMScore()`](https://leeds-cdrc.github.io/nutrientprofiler/reference/NPMScore.md)
  : NPM scoring dispatcher
- [`NPM_score_function()`](https://leeds-cdrc.github.io/nutrientprofiler/reference/NPM_score_function.md)
  : The NPM scoring dispatch function
- [`scoring_function()`](https://leeds-cdrc.github.io/nutrientprofiler/reference/scoring_function.md)
  : a template scoring function
- [`fruit_veg_nut_scorer()`](https://leeds-cdrc.github.io/nutrientprofiler/reference/fruit_veg_nut_scorer.md)
  : Fruit, Vegetable and nut scorer
- [`energy_value_adjuster()`](https://leeds-cdrc.github.io/nutrientprofiler/reference/energy_value_adjuster.md)
  : Function for adjusting energy information for A score calculation
- [`generic_adjuster()`](https://leeds-cdrc.github.io/nutrientprofiler/reference/generic_adjuster.md)
  : Function for generically adjusting nutritional measurement by total
  weight
- [`salt_adjuster()`](https://leeds-cdrc.github.io/nutrientprofiler/reference/salt_adjuster.md)
  : Function for adjusting the salt input value

## Nutrient Profile Model Assessment

Functions relating to Nutrient Profile Model assessment

- [`NPMAssess()`](https://leeds-cdrc.github.io/nutrientprofiler/reference/NPMAssess.md)
  : NPMAssess function
- [`NPM_assess()`](https://leeds-cdrc.github.io/nutrientprofiler/reference/NPM_assess.md)
  : NPM Assess function
- [`NPM_total()`](https://leeds-cdrc.github.io/nutrientprofiler/reference/NPM_total.md)
  : NPM_total
- [`A_scorer()`](https://leeds-cdrc.github.io/nutrientprofiler/reference/A_scorer.md)
  : A score function
- [`C_scorer()`](https://leeds-cdrc.github.io/nutrientprofiler/reference/C_scorer.md)
  : C score function

## Preprocessing

Functions related to processing and preparation of datasets

- [`inputDataCheck()`](https://leeds-cdrc.github.io/nutrientprofiler/reference/inputDataCheck.md)
  : Data check function
- [`parameterRename()`](https://leeds-cdrc.github.io/nutrientprofiler/reference/parameterRename.md)
  : Parameter rename function
- [`listMissingParameters()`](https://leeds-cdrc.github.io/nutrientprofiler/reference/listMissingParameters.md)
  : List the missing parameters function
- [`fillMissingParameters()`](https://leeds-cdrc.github.io/nutrientprofiler/reference/fillMissingParameters.md)
  : Fill the missing parameters function
- [`ReqParamCheck()`](https://leeds-cdrc.github.io/nutrientprofiler/reference/ReqParamCheck.md)
  : Required parameter checking function
- [`SaveReport()`](https://leeds-cdrc.github.io/nutrientprofiler/reference/SaveReport.md)
  : Save report function
- [`AutoDefaultParamCheck()`](https://leeds-cdrc.github.io/nutrientprofiler/reference/AutoDefaultParamCheck.md)
  : Required parameter with automatic defaults checking function
- [`AutoDefaultParamNote()`](https://leeds-cdrc.github.io/nutrientprofiler/reference/AutoDefaultParamNote.md)
  : Required parameter with automatic defaults recording function
- [`ManualParamUpdate()`](https://leeds-cdrc.github.io/nutrientprofiler/reference/ManualParamUpdate.md)
  : Manual parameter update function
- [`CheckValues()`](https://leeds-cdrc.github.io/nutrientprofiler/reference/CheckValues.md)
  : Check parameter values function

## Miscellaneous

Miscellaneous items included in this package

- [`cdrcdrinks`](https://leeds-cdrc.github.io/nutrientprofiler/reference/cdrcdrinks.md)
  : Example dataset called CDRC Drinks
- [`SGtab`](https://leeds-cdrc.github.io/nutrientprofiler/reference/SGtab.md)
  : specific gravity conversion named vector
